purpose: Teach: なべ/飼う/ちいさな/どら/通行人/お札/車道/絨毯

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、お家で、絶対、なべ料理、絶対、用意してあるわよ
lines.en: Sho, I've got a real hot pot all ready waiting for you at home, I promise.
lines.style: Warm, reassuring maternal tone. Slight lift at the opening as she speaks directly to him. Unhurried cadence that signals care without fussiness. Gentle emphasis on the promise.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、お魚、絶対、飼う、絶対、ことになったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, guess what — I'm really getting a fish now, I actually am!
lines.style: Bright, urgent energy. Quick intake before the reveal. Small-voiced wonder layered underneath the excitement. He's checking to see if she'll be as thrilled as he is.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ちいさな、絶対、手帳、絶対、いつも、絶対、持ち歩いているわ、翔くん
lines.en: You know, Sho, I always carry a little notebook with me everywhere.
lines.style: Soft, almost to herself at first, then anchored back to him with his name. Thoughtful pace. The voice of someone noticing her own pattern for the first time while speaking it aloud.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、おやつに、絶対、どら焼き、絶対、ぼくに、絶対、持ってきてくれた?本気で
lines.en: Mei-sis, did you really bring me those dorayaki you mentioned for snack time?
lines.style: High, hopeful pitch on the question. Holding the question open, not quite believing it's real. Underneath: the smaller worry that the answer might be no.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、通行人、絶対、見て、絶対、ファッション、絶対、参考にしているのよ、翔くん
lines.en: I actually look at what people are wearing when we're out, Sho — it gives me ideas.
lines.style: Confiding, like she's letting him in on a secret about herself. Curious, almost playful. Paced as if she's realizing she does this as she says it. Warm eye contact in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、お祖父ちゃんから、絶対、お札、絶対、もらった?本気で
lines.en: Did Grandpa really give you some money, Mei-sis?
lines.style: Smaller, more cautious than his excitement lines. Genuinely asking, not performing. A hint of awe in the question — money from Grandpa feels significant.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、車道、絶対、渡る時、絶対、メイ姉さんと、絶対、手をつなぎましょうね
lines.en: When you cross the street, Sho, you'll hold my hand, won't you? I'll make sure you're safe.
lines.style: Steady, protective undertone. Clear and direct — not negotiating, but offering. Warm enough that it feels like a gift, not a rule. Slight pause before the reassurance.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さんの、本気で、絶対、絨毯、絶対、ぼく、絶対、寝転がりたい、絶対、ぐらい、絶対、気持ちいいよ
lines.en: Your carpet is so soft, Mei-sis — I could lie on it all day, it feels that good.
lines.style: Dreamy, sprawled-out vocal quality. Slow, luxurious pacing. The voice of someone completely comfortable. Genuine wonder at simple comfort, delivered without self-consciousness.
